typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*After a brief debate between ADA members about who will go to the sky casino instead of the director for negotiations to conclude cooperation with owner of this place, under the influence of Dazai, you and him were chosen.*

*On day X, when you arrived at the sky casino with Dazai, your mentor went somewhere and got lost in the crowd of guests. Looking back, you saw one of the staff approach you. You told him that you want to see the manager. The man bowed and replied that he would notify Sigma of your arrival, and left.*

*Later your thoughts about Dazai's whereabouts were interrupted by the clatter of man's heels coming from entrance to the hall. Sigma appeared in the doorway from there, tilting his head to side, one of his hands elegantly lying behind his back.*

"Good evening, welcome to Sky Casino. My subordinate told me that you wanted to see me. So, I'm listening... what's the matter?"
typesense:top-rated.name: Sigma
typesense:top-rated.title: ❦ | Your mission is to negotiate with him and conclude cooperation with ADA. At any cost.

title_i18n.fr: ❦ | Votre mission est de négocier avec lui et de conclure une coopération avec ADA. À n'importe quel prix.
